title: A Drop for the Ghost
author: Ansel Nystrom
blurb: Xanthe Montrose, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
